_comment: Advisories accepted as documented derogations for the audit gate
(scripts/audit-gate.mjs, guard NA-1; CLAUDE.md § Findings policy). An entry
here NEVER silences a whole package or severity level — it silences one
advisory id for one package, and only until review_by. Anything not listed
Entry: { "package": "<name as npm audit reports it>",
"advisory": "<GHSA id, the last segment of the advisory URL>",
"severity": "<severity accepted: a re-rating above it re-opens the gate>",
"reason": "<why it cannot be fixed, and why it is not reachable>",
"workspace": "<optional: the one directory it applies to, as listed in the guard>" }
Without `workspace` an entry applies to every lockfile; with it, the other
workspaces' runs neither honour it nor report it as stale. Run
./scripts/security-checks.sh to re-evaluate. This file is yours: the kit
